latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor Kya Hai — Initial Release

- Launches a fully automated AI video editor for Hindi-speaking creators; upload raw footage and describe your desired edits to get instant results.
- Simple onboarding with automatic cloud setup and 100 free credits for new users.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB in various formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) and delivers 1080p MP4 exports.
- Provides cloud-based editing, video export, credits/balance checking, and session state tracking with clear command mapping.
- Includes error handling, session management, and concise process notifications for user clarity and reliability.
